description: This file defines the ILocalSiloDetails interface in the Orleans.Runtime namespace, which provides details about the local silo, including its name, cluster ID, host name, and addresses.

classes.name: ILocalSiloDetails
classes.description: Interface providing properties for details of the local silo, such as name, cluster ID, host name, and addresses.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Property to get the name of the silo.

methods.name: ClusterId
methods.description: Property to get the cluster identity of the silo.

methods.name: DnsHostName
methods.description: Property to get the DNS host name of the silo.

methods.name: SiloAddress
methods.description: Property to get the address of the silo's inter-silo endpoint.

methods.name: GatewayAddress
methods.description: Property to get the address of the silo's gateway proxy endpoint.
